text_block_list.text:
One day, a fan letter arrived for Tosen 
Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way!? Fan mail for me!? Totally insane, 
ain't I basically a superstar now!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, kinda makes me blush. Wonder what 
they wrote about me~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
About 30 minutes later, humming a tune, 
Tosen Jordan came back.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I really splurged! A new lip color, 
polarizing glitter nail polish, and 
then...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! A bunch of cosmetics! I just couldn't 
resist, so I bought 'em all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Because it was in a fan letter, you see—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
They're really keeping an eye on that kind 
of thing, huh? Seriously, I can't slack 
off at all~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I told her that perhaps it meant Tosen 
Jordan's hard work made her truly shine."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...No way! They're definitely 
complimenting my makeup too, I know it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, this makeup and nails and all, 
they're basically my trademark, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Some people complain that I'm too flashy, 
but like, why not just let 'em talk?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This is who I am! Let's show all the kids 
cheering for me just how bright I can 
sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Puffing out her chest as she said that, 
Tosen Jordan looked sparkly and cool.
